line_of_activity: Manufacturing of plastic packaging containers for FMCG companies
_assumptions_notes: Installed capacity: 3 existing machines + 1 new machine, each capable of 3,000,000 units/year at 100% utilisation = 12,000,000 units/year. Selling price per unit INR 5. Cost1 (raw material) per unit INR 2.5, Cost2 (power & fuel) per unit INR 0.3. Other variable cost (packaging, consumables) INR 0.2 per unit. Wages for 10 workers at INR 15,000/month each. Factory overheads include rent, insurance, etc. Repairs & maintenance for machinery. Admin expenses for office staff. Selling & distribution at 2% of sales. Land and building assumed already owned (no cost). New machine cost INR 60 lakhs. Depreciation rates as per standard. Working capital days based on industry norms: RM 15 days, FG 10 days, receivables 30 days, payables 45 days. Cash balance 2 lakhs. WC margin 25%.
